title: Air-quality monitoring
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Include dates and times of monitoring.
3. Document the name and location of the industrial facility.
4. Note the standard emission limits for the specific pollutants being monitored.
5. Detail the type of pollutants monitored (e.g., particulate matter, NOx, SOx, CO, VOCs).
6. Use precise and calibrated measuring devices to record the levels of emissions.
7. Provide a comparison between the measured emissions and the regulatory standards.
8. Indicate any episodes of emission exceedances, include duration, and peak levels.
9. Highlight any observations of visible emissions such as smoke, odors, or plumes.
10. Describe the meteorological conditions during the monitoring period.
11. Document whether any measurements were taken in compliance with government-approved monitoring protocols and guidelines.
12. Detail the methods used for quality assurance and quality control.
13. Describe any abnormal facility operations or maintenance activities that might have contributed to excessive emissions during the monitoring period.
14
